newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dollar firm, bonds ease on data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dollar firm, bonds ease on data.

text.p: The Australian dollar rose slightly and bonds eased after the third quarter capital expenditure report came in stronger than expectations.
The dollar rose to US$0.8139/43 from US$0.8134/39 just before the data, while the December 10-year bond futures contract eased to 92.960 from a pre-data 92.990.

Capital expenditure rose a seasonally adjusted 0.9 percent in the September quarter compared with median forecasts for a 3.0 percent fall, while the fourth estimate for business investment intentions was A$42.91 billion, up 7.8 percent from the third estimate.
